key_point: Zelda was the first NES game that could save, thanks to a battery in the cartridge
title: The Legend of Zelda was the first NES game that let you save.
caption: The Legend of Zelda was the first NES game that let you save. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #zelda #nintendo #nes

instagram.caption:
The Legend of Zelda was the first NES game that let you save.

Before it, long games made you write down passwords on paper. Zelda's gold cartridge had a small battery inside that kept your progress when the console was off.

Some of those batteries still hold a save almost 40 years later.

Do you still have your old save files?
